entries.en: The bookbinder reinforced the cover with a strip of buckram.
entries.zh: 装订师用一条粗硬布加固了封面。

entries.en: A soft whicker came from the stable as the rider approached.
entries.zh: 骑手走近时，马厩里传来一声轻柔的马嘶。

entries.en: The judge spoke weightily before announcing the fictional court's decision.
entries.zh: 法官在宣布虚构法庭的裁决前，语气庄重地讲话。

entries.en: She wore a narrow silver ring on her little finger.
entries.zh: 她在小指上戴着一枚细银戒指。

entries.en: The noise made the dog stop dead beside the gate.
entries.zh: 那声响使狗在大门旁突然停住。

entries.en: The labor history seminar examined a factory operating as an open shop.
entries.zh: 劳工史研讨会考察了一家实行自由雇佣制的工厂。

entries.en: The magazine printed a short horoscope for each star sign.
entries.zh: 杂志为每个星座刊登了一段简短的运势预测。

entries.en: The economics exercise compared a direct tax with a tax on purchases.
entries.zh: 经济学练习比较了直接税与购物税。

entries.en: The historical payslip listed a deduction for national insurance.
entries.zh: 这张历史工资单列有国民保险扣款。

entries.en: The tired reporter had to grind out another routine summary before midnight.
entries.zh: 疲惫的记者必须在午夜前费力写出另一篇例行摘要。

entries.en: The retiring librarian received unstinted praise from former colleagues.
entries.zh: 退休的图书馆员得到了昔日同事毫不吝惜的赞扬。

entries.en: His unmannerly interruption silenced the conversation around the table.
entries.zh: 他无礼的打断使桌边的谈话安静了下来。

entries.en: The inspector noticed the sponginess of the damaged packing material.
entries.zh: 检查员注意到了受损包装材料的海绵质地。

entries.en: The village gained a regular bus service after the new road opened.
entries.zh: 新公路通车后，村里有了定期公交服务。

entries.en: The maintenance man repaired the loose handrail before the building opened.
entries.zh: 维修员在大楼开放前修好了松动的扶手。

entries.en: The course compared social democracy with other political traditions of the period.
entries.zh: 课程比较了社会民主主义与该时期的其他政治传统。

entries.en: The children watched a shadow show projected onto a white screen.
entries.zh: 孩子们观看了一场投影在白色幕布上的影子戏。

entries.en: The electrical engineering lecture explained how skin effect changes current distribution.
entries.zh: 电气工程讲座解释了集肤效应如何改变电流分布。

entries.en: The fox decided to hightail it when the farmer opened the gate.
entries.zh: 农夫打开大门时，狐狸决定赶紧逃走。

entries.en: A lost suitcase was handed in at the police station.
entries.zh: 一个遗失的手提箱被交到了派出所。

entries.en: The manufacturer planned to rejig the factory for a different product.
entries.zh: 制造商计划重新装备工厂，以生产另一种产品。

entries.en: The travelers found plenteous food at the harvest celebration.
entries.zh: 旅客们在丰收庆典上看到了丰盛的食物。

entries.en: The collector showed us a silver half dollar from the old display case.
entries.zh: 收藏者给我们看了旧展柜里的一枚银质美元半元硬币。

entries.en: Please file away the signed forms after copying the reference numbers.
entries.zh: 抄下编号后，请把签好的表格存档。

entries.en: The exhibition traced changes in the computer industry through advertisements.
entries.zh: 展览通过广告追溯了计算机产业的变迁。

entries.en: The fictional tribunal examined evidence of a war crime committed during the retreat.
entries.zh: 虚构的法庭审查了撤退期间发生的一项战争罪行的证据。

entries.en: The engineer compared the signal-to-noise ratio before and after filtering.
entries.zh: 工程师比较了滤波前后的信噪比。

entries.en: The novelist explored human nature through a dispute over a lost inheritance.
entries.zh: 小说家通过一场遗产丢失引发的争议探讨了人性。

entries.en: The donor finally grew weary of the collector's repeated importunity.
entries.zh: 捐赠者最终厌倦了募集者一再纠缠恳求。

entries.en: The botanist studied the flowerless plants growing beneath the bridge.
entries.zh: 植物学家研究了桥下生长的无花植物。

entries.en: The biology lecture illustrated fissiparous reproduction with a sequence of microscope images.
entries.zh: 生物学讲座用一组显微镜图像演示了分裂生殖。

entries.en: The tutor marked word stress before asking the class to repeat the pronunciation.
entries.zh: 导师先标出了单词重音，然后让全班重复发音。

entries.en: The thief tried to make off with a bag of stolen watches.
entries.zh: 窃贼试图带着一袋偷来的手表逃走。

entries.en: The proposed budget included a line item for repairing school roofs.
entries.zh: 预算提案包含一项修缮学校屋顶的拨款项目。

entries.en: A fellow member of the photography club lent me a tripod.
entries.zh: 摄影俱乐部的一位同会会员借给我一个三脚架。

entries.en: The demonstration compared the material in its solid state with its melted form.
entries.zh: 演示比较了这种材料的固态与熔化后的形态。

entries.en: The film will flash back to the characters' first meeting after the opening scene.
entries.zh: 开场场景过后，影片将倒叙到角色们初次见面的情形。

entries.en: The medical history display included an unopened bottle labeled eyewash.
entries.zh: 医学史展览中有一瓶未开封、标有洗眼水字样的液体。

entries.en: The observatory archive contains astronomic calculations written in the previous century.
entries.zh: 天文台档案馆收藏着上个世纪写下的天文学计算记录。

entries.en: The teaching dataset listed body weight without including the participants' names.
entries.zh: 教学数据集列出了体重，但没有包含参与者姓名。

entries.en: The calendar exercise contrasted February in a common year with a leap year.
entries.zh: 日历练习比较了平年二月与闰年二月。

entries.en: The reporter hoped to sniff out inconsistencies in the official account.
entries.zh: 记者希望发现官方叙述中的矛盾。

entries.en: The diagram highlighted the brain and spinal cord as the central nervous system.
entries.zh: 示意图将脑与脊髓突出标为中枢神经系统。

entries.en: The archive collected posters associated with the early trade union movement.
entries.zh: 档案馆收藏了与早期工会运动相关的海报。

entries.en: We plan to set off before sunrise to avoid the afternoon heat.
entries.zh: 我们计划在日出前出发，以避开下午的炎热。

entries.en: The presenters held a dry run in the empty lecture hall.
entries.zh: 演讲者们在空教室里进行了一次彩排。

entries.en: The bakery sold a dense wheaten loaf beside its rye bread.
entries.zh: 面包店在黑麦面包旁出售一种质地紧实的小麦面包。

entries.en: My unpractised hands struggled with the delicate embroidery stitches.
entries.zh: 我不熟练的双手很难完成这些精细的刺绣针法。

entries.en: The audience applauded through a second curtain call.
entries.zh: 观众在第二次谢幕时仍不断鼓掌。

entries.en: The museum compressed cosmic time into a corridor-length illustrated timeline.
entries.zh: 博物馆将宇宙演化的时间压缩成一条走廊长度的图示时间线。

entries.en: The business editor requested a clearer chart for the factory-closure story.
entries.zh: 经济栏总编辑要求为工厂关闭的报道配一张更清晰的图表。

entries.en: The gardener began to pick off the damaged leaves.
entries.zh: 园丁开始摘掉受损的叶子。

entries.en: The historian examined disputes over ship money in seventeenth-century England.
entries.zh: 历史学者考察了十七世纪英格兰围绕造船税的争议。

entries.en: The logging exhibit showed a trip line attached to the hook in the log.
entries.zh: 伐木展览展示了一根连接在原木钩上的脱扣线。

entries.en: The chair tried to temporise until the missing report arrived.
entries.zh: 主席试图拖延时间，等缺失的报告送达。

entries.en: After the overnight journey, I felt spacey during the morning briefing.
entries.zh: 通宵旅行后，我在晨会时感到迷迷糊糊。

entries.en: The market stalls offered seasonable fruit from nearby farms.
entries.zh: 集市摊位出售附近农场送来的应季水果。

entries.en: This extra bag of rice will tide us over until payday.
entries.zh: 这袋额外的大米能让我们撑到发薪日。

entries.en: The captain received the most valuable player award after the final.
entries.zh: 决赛结束后，队长获得了最有价值球员奖。

entries.en: The company paid lip service to recycling but bought no collection bins.
entries.zh: 公司口头上支持回收，却没有购买回收箱。

entries.en: An unexpected turn of events left the understudy playing the lead.
entries.zh: 事态意外变化，使替补演员担任了主角。

entries.en: The old photograph shows a shop girl arranging hats in the window.
entries.zh: 这张旧照片展示了一位女售货员在橱窗里摆放帽子。

entries.en: The shortstop started a double play that ended the inning.
entries.zh: 游击手发动了一次结束这一局的双杀。

entries.en: The builders will close off the alley while repairing the wall.
entries.zh: 修墙期间，施工人员将封锁小巷。

entries.en: The gardener chose a scentless variety for the small indoor display.
entries.zh: 园丁为这个小型室内展示选择了一个无气味的品种。

entries.en: The archive's visitors were preponderantly students from nearby universities.
entries.zh: 档案馆的来访者大多是附近大学的学生。

entries.en: The critic wrote penetratingly about the film's treatment of memory.
entries.zh: 评论家敏锐地分析了影片对记忆的处理。

entries.en: The puzzle page included a word square with four letters along each side.
entries.zh: 谜题页上有一个每边四个字母的四方连词。

entries.en: The army officer donated a collection of campaign maps to the museum.
entries.zh: 这位陆军军官向博物馆捐赠了一批战役地图。

entries.en: The department appointed a full professor to chair the review panel.
entries.zh: 系里任命了一位正教授主持评审小组。

entries.en: The astronomy workbook compares a solar day with a sidereal day.
entries.zh: 天文学练习册比较了太阳日与恒星日。

entries.en: The food shop sold sandwiches and hot pastries near the station.
entries.zh: 车站附近的食品店出售三明治和热糕点。

entries.en: The biographer attributed the composer's exhaustion to years of overstrain.
entries.zh: 传记作者把作曲家的疲惫归因于多年的过劳。

entries.en: The jeweler's dextrous fingers adjusted the tiny clasp without scratching it.
entries.zh: 珠宝匠灵巧的手指调整了小扣环，没有将其刮伤。

entries.en: The baker sprinkled demerara over the apple tart before baking.
entries.zh: 面包师在烘烤前把德麦拉拉蔗糖撒在苹果挞上。

entries.en: The carpenter checked the shelf with a spirit level.
entries.zh: 木匠用气泡水准仪检查了架子的水平度。

entries.en: The comprehensive school welcomed pupils with a wide range of academic abilities.
entries.zh: 这所综合学校接收学习能力各异的学生。

entries.en: The philosophy class debated whether the fictional character acted through free will.
entries.zh: 哲学课讨论了这个虚构角色是否出于自由意志而行动。

entries.en: We watched the children hop out of the stationary minibus.
entries.zh: 我们看着孩子们从停着的小型巴士上跳下来。

entries.en: The novel's early chapters revolve about a disputed family photograph.
entries.zh: 小说前几章围绕一张引起争议的家庭照片展开。

entries.en: The junior school arranged a museum visit for its oldest pupils.
entries.zh: 这所小学为最高年级的学生安排了一次博物馆参观。

entries.en: The restorer copied the bead and quirk from an undamaged section of molding.
entries.zh: 修复师从一段完好的线脚上复制了圆凹饰。

entries.en: In the old story, chimney soot would colly the sweep's face.
entries.zh: 在这个旧故事中，烟囱煤灰会把扫烟囱工人的脸弄黑。

entries.en: The church museum displayed a small vessel once used to hold chrism.
entries.zh: 教会博物馆展示了一个曾用于盛放圣油的小容器。

entries.en: The reenactor carried a wooden buckler in the staged tournament.
entries.zh: 历史重演者在模拟比武中持有一面木制小圆盾。

entries.en: The chief financial officer questioned the assumptions behind the warehouse budget.
entries.zh: 财务长质疑了仓库预算背后的假设。

entries.en: The tutorial demonstrated a system command for displaying active processes.
entries.zh: 教程演示了一条用于显示活动进程的系统指令。

entries.en: The public utility company sent a crew to repair the damaged power line.
entries.zh: 公用事业公司派出一组人员维修受损电线。

entries.en: The café served a poor boy filled with cheese and roasted vegetables.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆供应了一份夹着奶酪和烤蔬菜的大三明治。

entries.en: The timber invoice quoted a price per board foot.
entries.zh: 木材发票列出了每板英尺的价格。

entries.en: The interview was full of friendly backchat between the two actors.
entries.zh: 采访中充满了两位演员之间友好诙谐的对话。

entries.en: The basket maker bent a flexible willow withe around the frame.
entries.zh: 编篮人将一根柔韧的柳条弯绕在框架上。

entries.en: The burned crust made most of the loaf uneatable.
entries.zh: 烧焦的外皮使大半条面包难以下咽。

entries.en: The gardener converted the disused coal house into a tool shed.
entries.zh: 园丁把废弃的煤库改成了工具棚。

entries.en: A peace officer directed visitors away from the damaged bridge.
entries.zh: 一名治安官员引导游客避开受损的桥。

entries.en: The captain recorded southwest by south as the next heading.
entries.zh: 船长把下一段航向记为西南偏南。

entries.en: The horse cleared the water jump without touching the far bank.
entries.zh: 马越过了水沟，没有碰到对岸边缘。

entries.en: The navigation worksheet marked a route heading southeast by south.
entries.zh: 导航练习纸标出了一条朝东南偏南行进的路线。

entries.en: A dark tidemark ran along the base of the harbor wall.
entries.zh: 港墙底部有一条深色潮痕。

entries.en: The costume designer chose a skintight silver outfit for the scene.
entries.zh: 服装设计师为这个场景选了一套银色紧身服。

entries.en: The mayor answered questions about the bridge at a news conference.
entries.zh: 市长在记者招待会上回答了有关桥梁的问题。

entries.en: The natural history display included notebooks from local birdwatchers.
entries.zh: 博物学展览中有当地观鸟者的笔记本。

entries.en: The old church tower served as a reference point on the walking map.
entries.zh: 旧教堂塔楼被用作步行地图上的参考点。

entries.en: In the simulation, the process accelerated beyond control after the sensor failed.
entries.zh: 在仿真中，传感器失效后，过程加速到了无法控制的程度。

entries.en: The workshop owner applied for a business loan to replace outdated equipment.
entries.zh: 工坊老板申请商业贷款，以更换过时设备。

entries.en: We heard the radio news while preparing breakfast at the campsite.
entries.zh: 我们在营地准备早餐时听到了广播新闻。

entries.en: The seedsman recommended varieties suited to the garden's short growing season.
entries.zh: 种子商推荐了适合花园短暂生长季的品种。

entries.en: A sandalled traveler waited beside the fountain with a rolled map.
entries.zh: 一位穿凉鞋的旅人拿着卷起的地图，在喷泉旁等候。

entries.en: The travel writer emphasized the shelter's primitiveness and lack of basic comforts.
entries.zh: 旅行作家强调了住所的简陋原始，以及基本舒适条件的缺乏。

entries.en: The veteran engineer's opinion would carry weight with the review board.
entries.zh: 这位资深工程师的意见会对评审委员会产生影响。

entries.en: The war film shows an empty body bag being unfolded beside a military vehicle.
entries.zh: 这部战争片展示了一个空装尸袋在军车旁被展开的情景。

entries.en: The composer arranged the passage using the twelve-tone system.
entries.zh: 作曲家用十二音制编排了这个乐段。

entries.en: The old novel uses a crazy house as the setting for its opening chapter.
entries.zh: 这部旧小说以一所所谓的疯人院作为开篇一章的场景。

entries.en: The workers struggled to pull the heavy crate along the rough floor.
entries.zh: 工人们吃力地沿着粗糙地面拖动沉重的板条箱。

entries.en: The shopkeeper packed loose black tea into a small paper bag.
entries.zh: 店主把散装红茶装进一个小纸袋。

entries.en: The student nurse attended a supervised training session in the simulation room.
entries.zh: 护生在模拟室参加了一次有指导人员监督的培训。

entries.en: An oldish man helped us find the entrance to the archive.
entries.zh: 一位有些年纪的男子帮我们找到了档案馆入口。

entries.en: The needlewoman repaired a torn seam in the actor's coat.
entries.zh: 缝纫女工修补了演员外套上一处裂开的接缝。

entries.en: The archive recorded the temporary lodgement of the collection in a neighboring museum.
entries.zh: 档案记载了这批藏品在邻近博物馆的临时存放。

entries.en: Engineers plan to test fly the restored aircraft before the exhibition opens.
entries.zh: 工程师计划在展览开幕前试飞修复后的飞机。

entries.en: Careful detective work linked the abandoned bicycle to the fictional burglary.
entries.zh: 细致的侦探工作将那辆废弃自行车与虚构的盗窃案联系起来。

entries.en: The technician identified a small computer system interface on the old scanner.
entries.zh: 技术人员在旧扫描仪上辨认出了一个小型计算机系统接口。

entries.en: The documentary described a cold war sustained through propaganda and diplomatic pressure.
entries.zh: 纪录片描述了一场通过宣传和外交压力维持的冷战。

entries.en: The psychology archive contained transcripts from a historical group therapy study.
entries.zh: 心理学档案包含一项早期集体治疗研究的文字记录。

entries.en: The play's intriguer secretly arranges a meeting between the rival heirs.
entries.zh: 剧中的阴谋者秘密安排了两位竞争继承人会面。

entries.en: The technician will instal the replacement pump after checking its connections.
entries.zh: 技术人员检查连接处后将安装替换水泵。

entries.en: The children went gaga over the model railway in the museum.
entries.zh: 孩子们对博物馆里的模型铁路着了迷。

entries.en: The fictional budget included car insurance as a recurring annual expense.
entries.zh: 这份虚构预算将汽车保险列为每年重复发生的费用。

entries.en: Heavy rain left loose gravel scattered across the road surface.
entries.zh: 大雨过后，松散的碎石散落在路面上。

entries.en: The history class compared debates about national debt in two different decades.
entries.zh: 历史课比较了两个不同年代关于国债的争论。

entries.en: The fictional landlord threatened legal action over the unpaid rent.
entries.zh: 虚构的房东扬言要因未付租金提起法律诉讼。

entries.en: The expedition leader checked that the first-aid kit was in the supply crate.
entries.zh: 考察队领队确认了急救箱在补给箱里。

entries.en: The story's wealthy man funds a library in his childhood village.
entries.zh: 故事中的富裕男子出资在自己童年居住的村庄建了一座图书馆。

entries.en: The shop boy carried a parcel to the waiting delivery driver.
entries.zh: 年轻的男店伙计把包裹送到了等候的送货司机手上。

entries.en: The escapologist took a bow after emerging from the locked cabinet.
entries.zh: 脱身术表演者从锁着的柜子里出来后鞠躬谢幕。

entries.en: The critic's donnish comments dwelt on obscure references instead of the story.
entries.zh: 评论家学究式的评论纠缠于冷僻典故，而没有着眼于故事。

entries.en: The fictional inspector refused to connive at the falsification of safety records.
entries.zh: 虚构的检查员拒绝默许篡改安全记录的行为。

entries.en: The school organized a fun run to raise money for the library.
entries.zh: 学校组织了一场趣味募捐长跑，为图书馆筹款。

entries.en: The soldier's diary describes a cold night on sentry go.
entries.zh: 士兵的日记描述了一个执行步哨勤务的寒夜。

entries.en: The lecturer used economic theory to explain the firm's pricing choices.
entries.zh: 讲师用经济理论解释了企业的定价选择。

entries.en: The Scottish estate hired a law agent to handle the disputed sale.
entries.zh: 这个苏格兰庄园聘请了一位诉讼代理人处理有争议的出售事宜。

entries.en: We built a small wooden toolbox in shop class.
entries.zh: 我们在手工艺课上制作了一个小木工具箱。

entries.en: The interview explored how a religious person understood the old pilgrimage route.
entries.zh: 采访探讨了一位宗教信仰者如何理解这条古老的朝圣路线。

entries.en: His dandyish costume included polished shoes and an elaborate silk waistcoat.
entries.zh: 他那身讲究的花花公子式装束包括锃亮的皮鞋和精美的丝绸马甲。

entries.en: The botanical drawing showed four petals in a cruciate arrangement.
entries.zh: 植物绘图展示了四片花瓣呈十字形排列。

entries.en: The travelers paused at a crossway to consult their map.
entries.zh: 旅客们在一个十字路口停下来查看地图。

entries.en: The conductor invited the young soloist to take a bow.
entries.zh: 指挥邀请年轻的独奏者鞠躬谢幕。

entries.en: The football stopped just short of the next yard line.
entries.zh: 橄榄球停在了下一条码线前不远处。

entries.en: The long jump was her favorite field event at the school meet.
entries.zh: 跳远是她在学校运动会上最喜欢的田赛项目。

entries.en: The archive stored the original insurance policy with the ship's ownership papers.
entries.zh: 档案馆将保险单原件与船舶所有权文件一起存放。

entries.en: The plant pathology archive records an outbreak of yellow dwarf of potato.
entries.zh: 植物病理学档案记载了一次马铃薯黄矮病的暴发。

entries.en: The family rented a small beach house for the school holidays.
entries.zh: 这家人在学校假期租了一幢小型海滨别墅。

entries.en: The young scientist regarded her patient laboratory supervisor as a role model.
entries.zh: 这位年轻科学家把耐心的实验室导师视为榜样。

entries.en: A cracked blue vase stood on the marble chimneypiece.
entries.zh: 大理石壁炉架上摆着一只开裂的蓝花瓶。

entries.en: The historical manuscript describes attempts to cauterise wounds for disinfection.
entries.zh: 这份历史手稿描述了试图通过烧灼伤口进行消毒的做法。

entries.en: The model showed the beam lying athwart, at right angles to the ship's center line.
entries.zh: 模型显示横梁横跨放置，与船舶中心线成直角。

entries.en: The manual describes a control function that pauses data transmission during maintenance.
entries.zh: 手册描述了一项在维护期间暂停数据传输的控制功能。

entries.en: The cricket team prepared for a test match against the visiting side.
entries.zh: 板球队为与来访球队进行一场国际测试赛作准备。

entries.en: The commercial law lecture examined a fictional dispute between two trading firms.
entries.zh: 商法讲座考察了两家贸易公司之间的一起虚构争议。

entries.en: The van had to back up to let the tractor pass.
entries.zh: 货车必须倒车，才能让拖拉机通过。

entries.en: The pot began to boil over while we were setting the table.
entries.zh: 我们摆餐具时，锅里的东西开始沸腾溢出。

entries.en: The committee refused to back down from its demand for a public hearing.
entries.zh: 委员会拒绝放弃举行公开听证会的要求。

entries.en: The partners discussed the revised contract over a business lunch.
entries.zh: 合伙人在工作午餐期间讨论了修订后的合同。

entries.en: The retired actor smiled reminiscently at the old theater poster.
entries.zh: 退休演员望着旧剧院海报，怀旧地笑了。

entries.en: The economic history essay examined reflation after a prolonged period of falling prices.
entries.zh: 经济史论文考察了长期物价下降后的通货再膨胀。

entries.en: The historical map marked a supply line through the mountain pass.
entries.zh: 历史地图标出了一条穿过山口的补给线。

entries.en: Three schools sent teams to the weekend track meet.
entries.zh: 三所学校派队参加了周末的田径运动会。

entries.en: An invisible control character caused the text to break onto another line.
entries.zh: 一个不可见的控制字符使文本换到了另一行。

entries.en: The quiet student began to blossom out after joining the drama club.
entries.zh: 那位安静的学生加入戏剧社后开始成长起来。

entries.en: The teacher changed the note value while keeping the pitch unchanged.
entries.zh: 老师改变了音符时值，同时保持音高不变。

entries.en: The designer tested the instructions with an end user unfamiliar with the device.
entries.zh: 设计师让一位不熟悉设备的最终用户试用了说明书。

entries.en: The museum displayed a kris with an intricately carved wooden handle.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一把木柄雕刻精细的波状刃短剑。

entries.en: The king turned wrathfully toward the messenger in the final scene.
entries.zh: 在最后一幕中，国王愤怒地转向信使。

entries.en: The old telephone book listed a business that had long since closed.
entries.zh: 旧电话号码簿上列着一家早已关闭的企业。

entries.en: The loose roof panel could blow off in a strong storm.
entries.zh: 松动的屋顶板可能会在强风暴中被吹掉。

entries.en: The warehouse clerk checked the stock list before ordering more bolts.
entries.zh: 仓库文员在订购更多螺栓前查看了存货单。

entries.en: The charity provided financial aid to repair the community workshop.
entries.zh: 慈善机构提供了经济援助，用于修复社区工坊。

entries.en: The cook used a small spoon to scoop out the melon seeds.
entries.zh: 厨师用一把小勺舀出了瓜籽。

entries.en: The exercise calculated a paper loss without assuming that the shares were sold.
entries.zh: 这道练习在不假定股票已售出的情况下计算了账面损失。
